description_en: Enables or disables the failover with hot replica feature for a node in a cluster
description_zh: 开启或关闭集群热备节点
kebab_example: aliyun polardb modify-db-node-hot-replica-mode --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000000 --db-node-id pi-00000000000000000 --hot-replica-mode ON --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBNodeHotReplicaMode

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cluster.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html operation to query the details of the clusters that belong to your Alibaba Cloud account, such as cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
> 您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html接口查看账号下所有集群的详细信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the node in the cluster
parameters.name: db_node_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the hot standby feature. Valid values:

*   **ON**
*   **OFF**
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启热备。取值范围：

- **ON**：开启

- **OFF**：关闭
parameters.name: hot_replica_mode
